title: Flying the glideslope
summary: Nine miles out on Logan's ILS, autopilot off: fly both needles down to 500 ft by hand.
briefing: Nine miles from Boston's four right, on the glideslope, gear down, flaps twenty-five, and the autopilot is off. She's yours.
Pitch moves you on the glideslope, the bank on the localizer. Make small corrections and hold each one: the jumbo answers slowly, and the needles answer more slowly still.

tasks.goal: Fly the ILS by hand down to 500 ft.
tasks.say: Fly the needles down to five hundred feet. The glideslope diamond above the centre means fly up; below means fly down.
tasks.sayGlass: Fly the deviation scales down to five hundred feet: the glideslope diamond on the right of the attitude, the localizer below it. Diamond high, fly up; low, fly down.
tasks.done: Five hundred feet. You flew that.

cues.say: We're high: a little more descent.
The localizer's to the left: a little left bank.
Localizer to the right: correct right.

debrief.three: Both needles in the middle all the way down. A training captain would sign that.
debrief.two: On the ILS the whole way. Hold your corrections a little longer.
debrief.one: We made five hundred feet, but the needles wandered. Smaller, steadier corrections.
debrief.failed: We drifted too far off the beams. Small corrections, held. Shall we go again?
